title: Prove the exact rational GL3 two-column kernel (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof with an exhaustive finite certificate: the characteristic-zero two-column action of GL_3(F2) has image dimension 150 and an exact 18-dimensional kernel generated by

```text
E = 6[1] - 2 sum_(order g=2)[g] + 2 sum_(order g=4)[g] - sum_(order g=7)[g]
E^2 = 56E
ker(rho_2) = Q[GL3]E
```

A literal restored two-register shear is formally nonidentity but passes every input at widths one and two. A third-column regular orbit exposes it and recovers every formal address-algebra coefficient. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Only `research/gl3-rational-two-column-kernel/` is added.

The new result is the complete characteristic-zero kernel and restored witness. Ywz65's #2599 supplies the distinct binary-payload boundary and standard regular-orbit method; its group norm does not vanish over Q. Credit woklerx #1440 for finite-address certification, Jacob Alan Sussman #4628 for the complex small-unit context, and the predecessor lineage recorded in the package. No predecessor verifier or census was replayed.

## Evidence

Before: a two-column complex address test had no kernel description in the cited stream package. After: all 4,096 entries of rho_2(E) vanish exactly; integer convolution proves E^2=56E; a 150 by 150 Gram minor has determinant 15033 modulo the checked prime 65537. The idempotent trace gives the matching kernel dimension 18. No modular upper-rank inference is used.

The verifier constructs the 168-element group in two ways, checks centrality against every group element, executes all 144 dirty input columns at widths one and two, and executes the width-three witness with 112 nonzero entries. All four omitted-order-class controls are rejected, and the characteristic-zero group norm remains visible. Generated receipts bind all six package files by SHA256.

Both warning-strict registered commands pass locally, normal and optimized, each measured at about 0.24 seconds on CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64. The registered package replay, exact committed-byte/source-history preflight, committed export integrity and read-only Git-free optimized replay pass. Normal and optimized receipts agree. An existing receipt path is rejected without overwriting it.

From the repository root, reproduce with the exact available interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/gl3-rational-two-column-kernel/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/gl3-rational-two-column-kernel/verify.py

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/gl3-rational-two-column-kernel --check-source-history
```

Expected first direct output is `PASS_GL3_RATIONAL_TWO_COLUMN_KERNEL group=168 image=150 kernel=18 E_squared=56E support=112 dirty_columns=144 no_new_kappa`.

## Limitations

This certifies the Q or C address permutation algebra. It supplies no paid-call optimum, phase-letter theorem, complete complex unit, supplier admission or new kappa. Physical movement, precision, restoration price, compiler, stock and outer costs remain unknown. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review, Lean builds and the complete selected scientific replay are unrun.

The selected source-binding orientation command was attempted and stopped at `Invalid selected file: research/fresh-helper-thinned/PROOF.md`, which is omitted from this sparse checkout. It is not evidence against the selected construction, and this self-contained package does not depend on that file. The selected record, source manifest and linked review were read.

Base and pre-submission canonical main are `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. The changed card scope and dated overlap coverage are explicit in TASK.json. Sparse notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside that coverage.

## Open next questions

- Determine the characteristic-zero kernel for AGL3(F2) at its last unfaithful width, starting from exact orbit and Gram data.
- For one pinned candidate with paid calls or phases, identify a sufficient finite tensor width or a formal algebra certificate. The address-only result does not supply that extension.

## Related open work

- #4628 studies complex small units with binary address maps, mixing, phases and paid calls. This contribution identifies only the exact address-algebra test kernel; it neither audits nor improves the predecessor's call bounds.
- #4813 proposes a five-array block-three complex schedule. This result concerns finite testing of its address-only algebra, supplies no check of that proposal and has no overlapping call-count computation.
- #4828 proves conditioning of a different complete two-bank complex port. Its operator-norm quantity differs from this address-algebra image rank.
- #4825 computes rank 100 for a particular width-four partial channel. That coefficient and 4,096-dimensional action differ from the full two-column GL3 group-algebra map of rank 150 here, so these numbers are not competing counts.

This account's open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-22 21:15:18 UTC were refreshed before DONE. Related #4825 and #4828 are already listed above and concern different operators or quantities. The other new contributions study Toeplitz cuts, scalar-projector prices, integer splitting or signed prime-field connectors. No competing count for this exact characteristic-zero GL3 kernel was found in that snapshot; no extra predecessor computation was run.
